card.name: Word-start "ph" pieces in long words
card.fires_on: The letters F, ph or PH when they begin or sit inside a longer word, such as phlebotomy, phosphorylation, photometers, phosphatemia or PHOTOS. It often fires on a split-off "ph" piece before the rest of the word.
